format: NDCA Sanctioned events, replacement of a withdrawn couple between rounds

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: If a couple withdraws after any round and before the next round starts, the chairman may at his discretion replace it with the next eligible couple.

requirement: A future NDCA profile may offer a Chairman-controlled replacement workflow: verify the next eligible couple, preserve historical rounds and ballots, and audit the Chairman's decision. Never automatic.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI. Studio never replaces a withdrawn finalist.
interpretation_notes: Discretionary (may), Chairman-controlled. Needs the event-level Chairman designation (OD-06/OD-17, PR 834), correction and versioning rules (OD-07, PR 838) and withdrawal handling (OD-08, PR 840, where OD08-NDCA-0002 records III.D.31 as requires_interpretation; this entry is the OD-21 implementation requirement). PR 840 reports no wording difference in III.D.31 between June and July 2026; that report was read but not independently re-verified here.
decision_refs: OD-21 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve Studio/Custom minimum-participation and withdrawal rules for initial activation; retrospective audit PR #795)
